title: Isolation and Characterization of Murine Bone Marrow-Derived Eosinophils Post Bacterial Challenge
author: Parrish, Williams, et al.

steps.title: Prepare cytokine stocks
steps.instruction: Reconstitute and aliquot cytokines for eosinophil differentiation, then filter‑sterilize.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge lyophilized rmFLT‑3L and rmSCF briefly, reconstitute each in 1 mL 0.1 % BSA/PBS, aliquot 500 µL, store at –80 °C, and filter‑sterilize through a 0.22 µm filter.
Centrifuge lyophilized rmIL‑5 briefly, reconstitute in 1 mL 0.1 % BSA/PBS, aliquot 100 µL, store at –80 °C (no filtration required).

steps.title: Seed eosinophils in assay plates
steps.instruction: Plate bone‑marrow‑derived eosinophils (bmEos) in 96‑well plates at the appropriate density and allow recovery.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 µL of approximately 1 × 10⁴–1 × 10⁵ bmEos per well of a 96‑well plate.
Incubate the plate for at least 24 h before infection to let cells return to a basal state.
Count eosinophils with a hemocytometer to set the bacterial MOI; avoid seeding >1 × 10⁶ cells per well.

steps.title: Prepare Bordet‑Gengou agar plates
steps.instruction: Make selective blood agar for Bordetella plating and store plates for up to one month.

substeps.instruction: Dissolve 30 g L⁻¹ Bordet‑Gengou agar base in deionized water, add 10 g L⁻¹ 100 % glycerol, and autoclave at 121 °C for 15 min.
Cool the molten agar to 45–50 °C, then aseptically add 1 mL streptomycin (20 mg mL⁻¹) and 10–15 % defibrinated sheep’s blood pre‑warmed to 27–37 °C; swirl gently to avoid bubbles.
Pour ~20 mL of the cooled agar into each 100 mm × 15 mm petri dish, let solidify at room temperature, and store at 4 °C (up to 1 month).

steps.title: Prepare bacterial liquid culture
steps.instruction: Set up an overnight Bordetella broth culture for inoculum preparation.

substeps.instruction: In a sterile 15 mL conical tube, add 5 mL sterilized Miller’s LB broth (Fisher Cat. #BP9723) over a Bunsen flame.
Using a sterile 10 µL inoculation loop, pick a single colony of B. bronchiseptica RB50 from a BGS agar stock plate and inoculate the LB broth.
Incubate at 37 °C with shaking at 200 rpm overnight (8–12 h) until the culture reaches OD₆₀₀ 0.75–0.80; keep the cap slightly open for aeration.

steps.title: Determine bacterial concentration
steps.instruction: Measure optical density and adjust the culture to the desired CFU mL⁻¹.

substeps.instruction: Measure OD₆₀₀ of the overnight culture; do not use cultures with OD₆₀₀ ≥ 0.9–1.0 (stationary phase).
For Bordetella spp., OD₆₀₀ = 0.1 corresponds to 1 × 10⁸ CFU mL⁻¹. Dilute the culture in PBS or media to achieve exactly 1 × 10⁸ CFU mL⁻¹.

steps.title: Prepare bacterial inoculum for infection
steps.instruction: Calculate and make the inoculum that yields the desired MOI for bmEos.

substeps.instruction: From the bmEos seeding density (≈1 × 10⁴–1 × 10⁵ cells per well), decide on an MOI (recommended 0.1; do not exceed 10).
Use the formula Vi × Ci = Vf × Cf to compute the volume of the 1 × 10⁸ CFU mL⁻¹ stock needed for the final volume (Vf) that will be added to each well.

Optional opsonization: spin down the 0.1 OD₆₀₀ inoculum, discard supernatant, resuspend in 0.5 mL mouse serum and incubate 1 h at 37 °C, 200 rpm; spin again and resuspend in Base Media #3 before infection.

steps.title: Plate bacterial dilutions for CFU count
steps.instruction: Create serial dilutions of the inoculum and plate on BGS agar to verify concentration.

substeps.instruction: Prepare at least three 10‑fold serial dilutions of the inoculum in sterile PBS.
Plate 100 µL of each dilution onto BG blood agar containing 20 ng mL⁻¹ streptomycin.
Incubate plates at 37 °C for 48 h (or species‑specific time), then count colonies in the 20–200 range and calculate CFU mL⁻¹.

steps.title: Flow‑cytometry staining of bmEos
steps.instruction: Stain differentiated eosinophils for purity assessment and acquire data.

substeps.instruction: Prepare antibody solutions (see Table 1): Zombie Yellow 1:500, anti‑CD170 (Siglec‑F) PE 1:200, TruStain FcX 1:200, anti‑CD11b AF488 1:2000; keep on ice and use the same day.
Resuspend Day‑15 bmEos at 1 × 10⁶ cells mL⁻¹ in PBS (15 mL tube).
Centrifuge 300 × g, 5 min, 4 °C; discard supernatant.
Incubate cells with Zombie Yellow live/dead stain 30 min, 4 °C, dark.
Wash with 3 mL PBS + 0.1 % BSA; centrifuge 300 × g, 5 min, 4 °C.
Resuspend in 50 µL anti‑CD16/CD32 Fc‑block; incubate 30 min, 27 °C (or RT).
Centrifuge, discard supernatant; add 50 µL anti‑Siglec‑F‑PE in FACS buffer; incubate 30 min, 4 °C, dark.
Centrifuge, wash twice with 100 µL FACS buffer.
Resuspend in 4 % PFA‑FACS solution; incubate 1 h, 4 °C, dark.
Centrifuge, wash twice with 100 µL FACS buffer.
Resuspend final pellet in 100 µL FACS buffer for acquisition.
Optional pause: store at 4 °C overnight before acquisition.
Acquire ≥15 000 positive events (minimum 1.5 × 10⁴; aim for 30 000) on the flow cytometer and confirm CD11b⁺Siglec‑F^hi purity.

steps.title: Eosinophil cytotoxicity assay
steps.instruction: Measure eosinophil death over time after bacterial challenge using a plate reader.

substeps.instruction: Collect supernatant from a T‑75 flask of bmEos, transfer to a 15 mL tube and centrifuge 300 × g, 10 min.
Discard supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 15 mL Supplemented Base Media #3 (contains rmIL‑5, propidium iodide, HEPES; phenol‑red‑free).
Load the cell suspension into a black 96‑well plate (100 µL per well).
Add the prepared bacterial inoculum to each well and centrifuge the plate 300 × g, 5 min.
Include control wells: eosinophils alone, bacteria alone, 20 ng mL⁻¹ LPS, and 1 % Triton‑X‑100.
Plate two wells per control for bacterial counts.
Run at least three technical replicates per condition; repeat the entire experiment ≥4 independent times.
Place the plate in a TECAN Spark microplate reader set to 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.
Run the assay overnight (≥10 h) with absorbance/fluorescence readings every 30 min.

steps.title: Bactericidal/internalization assay
steps.instruction: Quantify bacterial survival after co‑culture with eosinophils at multiple time points.

substeps.instruction: After loading bmEos and bacterial inoculum, centrifuge the 96‑well plate 300 × g, 5 min.
Use an MOI of 0.01–0.1 (do not exceed 10).
At time 0, collect 100 µL from each well into an Eppendorf tube; return the plate to the incubator.
Vortex each collected sample, perform a series of 10‑fold dilutions in sterile PBS, and plate 100 µL of each dilution onto BGS agar.
Include a dedicated row of eosinophil‑only wells plated undiluted at every time point to monitor contamination.
Repeat sampling at 30 min, 2 h, 4 h, and 8 h post‑infection.
Incubate all BGS plates at 37 °C for 48 h, then count colonies and calculate CFU mL⁻¹ using the appropriate dilution factor.
Plot log₁₀ CFU mL⁻¹ versus time.
Optional extensions: collect RNA for qRT‑PCR, harvest supernatants for cytokine analysis, or perform flow cytometry with labeled bacteria to assess internalization.

steps.title: Multiplex ELISA on supernatants
steps.instruction: Measure cytokine/chemokine concentrations in eosinophil‑bacteria co‑culture supernatants using a LEGENDplex kit.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a 96‑well plate, reserving two columns for the standard curve.
Vortex the pre‑mixed bead suspension for ≥1 min.
Dilute 25 µL wash buffer in 475 µL deionized water (dH₂O).
Prepare the highest‑concentration standard (C7) and incubate at room temperature 10 min.
Add 75 µL assay buffer to tubes for standards C6–C1; perform serial 1:4 dilutions by adding 25 µL of the previous standard to the next tube, vortexing after each transfer.
To each standard‑designated well add 25 µL assay buffer, 25 µL standard solution, and 25 µL bead solution (final volume 75 µL).
To each sample well add 25 µL assay buffer, 25 µL sample, and 25 µL bead solution (75 µL total).
Seal the plate and protect from light.
Shake at 800 rpm for 2 h at 27 °C.
Centrifuge 250 × g, 5 min; discard supernatant.
Add 200 µL wash buffer, incubate 1 min protected from light, centrifuge 250 × g, 5 min, discard supernatant.
Add another 200 µL wash buffer, mix, incubate 1 min, centrifuge 250 × g, 5 min, then add 25 µL detection antibody; seal.
Shake 800 rpm for 1 h at 27 °C.
Add 25 µL Streptavidin‑Phycoerythrin (SA‑PE) without mixing; seal.
Shake 800 rpm for 30 min at 27 °C.
Spin 250 × g, 5 min, discard supernatant, add 200 µL wash buffer, cover with foil, incubate 1 min.
Repeat wash step once more, then resuspend the final pellet in 150 µL wash buffer.
Acquire data on a flow cytometer according to the kit’s analysis software.
